simple.summary: תַּלְבֹּשֶׁת (talbôsheth) means a garment First listed occurrence: Isa 59 17.

definitions.full: H8516. tilbosheth תִּלְבּשֶׁת noun feminine raiment ; — ת נָקָם בִּגְדֵי ׳וַיִּלְבַּשׁ Isa 59:17 and he put on garments of vengeance as raiment (of ׳י as champion of Israel).
